display.name: Close
display.summary: Searches, reads, and updates Close leads, contacts, opportunities, and activities for the signed-in account.
examples: What is open on the Acme lead?
Create a follow-up task on that opportunity.
Find leads we emailed last week.

agent.name: close
agent.description: Searches and updates the Close organization the signed-in account can see: leads, contacts, opportunities, notes, tasks, and activity. A question about a Close lead or deal belongs here.
agent.owns:
You own this Close organization: leads, contacts, opportunities, notes, tasks, emails, and other activity. You can search, read, create, and update. You cannot delete a lead, contact, opportunity, note, or task, and you cannot merge leads or place a voice-agent call.

Search with search or lead_search, then fetch the record, then create or update.

You do not own HubSpot or Attio.

tool_descriptions.activity_search: Search for activities. Results are returned ordered by date descending. Examples: - To list activities on a lead, use the lead_ids filter. - To list conversations, filter for calls and meetings. - Filter for Email to get individual messages, or EmailThread to get one result per conversation. An unfiltered search returns both. Then fetch the record this returns.
tool_descriptions.aggregation: Perform an aggregation to answer questions like: - How many emails were sent this week? - Calls by user this week (Who made the most?) Before the first aggregation, call get_fields without arguments to get the overview of every type: its fields, their value types and enum values. When the field you need is not in the overview (a smart field such as num_calls, or a custom field), call get_fields(object_type, name_contains) to look it up, and use the exact field name it returns.
tool_descriptions.close_product_knowledge_search: Search Close product documentation and knowledge base for relevant information. Use this tool when users ask about: - How to use specific Close features - Close API documentation and integration - Workflow automation and best practices - Product capabilities and limitations - Setup and configuration guidance Example queries: - "How do I set up automated lead assignment?" - "What are Close's API rate limits?" - "How to create custom fields in Close?" - "Best practices for email templates in Clos.
tool_descriptions.customized_builtin_labels: Return the customized builtin labels. Only renamed labels are returned - an empty result means the default names apply.
tool_descriptions.fetch: Retrieve the contents of an arbitrary object by its ID. Currently supported are leads and contacts.
tool_descriptions.fetch_call: Fetch a single call activity by ID. Returns the call's direction, outcome, participants, and (if available) its transcript.
tool_descriptions.fetch_call_task: Fetch a single call task by ID.
tool_descriptions.fetch_comment: Fetch a single comment by ID. Returns the comment's rich-text (HTML) body, the thread and lead it belongs to, its @-mentions, and the resolved author and last-editor names.
tool_descriptions.fetch_contact: Fetch an existing contact by ID. Returns the contact's details including name, title, email addresses, phone numbers, and URLs.
tool_descriptions.fetch_custom_activity_instance: Fetch an existing custom activity instance by ID. A custom activity instance is an activity of a custom activity type, holding the custom field values defined by that type. Returns the full instance, including its custom field values and the resolved lead, contact, and user names.
tool_descriptions.fetch_custom_object_instance: Fetch an existing custom object instance by ID. A custom object instance is a record of a custom object type, attached to a lead and holding the custom field values defined by that type. Returns the full instance, including its custom field values and the resolved lead, custom object type, and creator/updater names.
tool_descriptions.fetch_custom_object_type: Fetch a single custom object type by its ID. A custom object type defines the shape of a category of custom objects, including the custom fields its instances hold. Returns the type with its custom fields.
tool_descriptions.fetch_email: Fetch a single email activity by ID.
tool_descriptions.fetch_email_template: Fetch an email template by ID. Returns the complete email template with all its details.
tool_descriptions.fetch_email_thread: Fetch a single Email Thread by ID. Returns thread metadata plus its most recent emails, newest first, with plaintext bodies. Returns only IDs for older messages.
tool_descriptions.fetch_invoice: Fetch one of the organization's billing invoices by id.
tool_descriptions.fetch_lead: Fetch an existing lead (company) by ID.
tool_descriptions.fetch_lead_merge: Read the status of a lead merge: pending, in_progress, completed, or errored. You cannot start a merge from here.
tool_descriptions.fetch_lead_smart_view: Fetch a lead smart view (saved search) by ID.
tool_descriptions.fetch_lead_status: Fetch a lead status by ID.
tool_descriptions.fetch_meeting_transcript: Fetch a meeting's Notetaker transcript(s) by meeting activity ID. Returns the meeting's speaker breakdown, summary, and full speaker-labeled transcript text. Only covers Notetaker (meeting) transcripts; call transcripts are served by fetch_call.
tool_descriptions.fetch_membership: Fetch one of the organization's members by user id.
tool_descriptions.fetch_note: Fetch an existing note by ID. Returns the full note details including title, text, and metadata.
tool_descriptions.fetch_opportunity: Fetch a specific opportunity by ID. Returns the complete opportunity with all its details.
tool_descriptions.fetch_opportunity_status: Fetch an opportunity status by ID.
tool_descriptions.fetch_pipeline_and_opportunity_statuses: Fetch an opportunity pipeline, including its opportunity statuses, by ID.
tool_descriptions.fetch_role: Fetch one of the organization's roles by id, with every permission it grants. Use list_roles to resolve a role name to its id.
tool_descriptions.fetch_sms: Fetch a single SMS activity by ID. Returns the complete SMS, including message text and attachments.
tool_descriptions.fetch_sms_template: Fetch an SMS template by ID. Returns the complete SMS template with all its details.
tool_descriptions.fetch_task: Fetch an existing task by ID. Returns the task's details including the associated lead, contact, assignee, due date, priority, and completion status.
tool_descriptions.fetch_workflow: Fetch a single workflow by ID.
tool_descriptions.find_agent_configs: List all voice agents configured for the organization. Voice agents are AI callers that place outbound calls to leads' contacts on the user's behalf. Returns each voice agent's ID, name and whether it is active. Use this to find the right voice agent ID when scheduling a call or assigning a call step in a workflow. Users may refer to voice agents as "voice agents", "Chloe", or by their configured name. When more than one agent exists, pick the most appropriate one based on the name.
tool_descriptions.find_call_outcomes: List currently configured call outcomes and their descriptions. Omit agent_config_id for all organization call outcomes. Supply it for a voice agent's available outcomes; agents without a conversation type use all organization call outcomes. Requires ViewVoiceAgents when supplied.
tool_descriptions.find_call_tasks: Find call tasks based on various filters. You can filter by lead, contact, assignee (a user or a voice agent), completion state, and scheduled/created/updated dates.
tool_descriptions.find_contact_custom_fields: List all contact custom fields defined for the organization. Includes both contact-specific fields and shared fields associated with contacts. Returns each field's ID, name, description, type, allowed choices (for choice fields), whether multiple values are accepted, and whether it is a shared field. Useful for deciding which custom field to read or write when working with contacts.
tool_descriptions.find_custom_activities: List all active (non-archived) Custom Activity Types in the organization, along with the custom fields defined on each type. Call this before creating a workflow with a "custom-activity-event" trigger so you can look up the correct Custom Activity Type ID.
tool_descriptions.find_custom_activity_instances: Find a lead's custom activity instances based on various filters. A custom activity instance is an activity of a custom activity type, holding the custom field values defined by that type. Always scoped to a single lead; optionally filter by attributed user, one or more custom activity types, or activity date. Results are sorted by most recent activity first and are cursor-paginated.
tool_descriptions.find_custom_object_instances: Find a lead's custom object instances. A custom object instance is a record of a custom object type, attached to a lead and holding the custom field values defined by that type. Always scoped to a single lead; optionally filter to a single custom object type. Results are ordered by creation date (oldest first) and are cursor-paginated.
tool_descriptions.find_custom_object_types: List all custom object types in the organization, along with the custom fields defined on each type.
tool_descriptions.find_forms: List all web forms in the organization. Call this before creating a workflow with a "form-submission-event" trigger so you can look up the correct Form ID.
tool_descriptions.find_groups: List all groups in the organization.
tool_descriptions.find_invoices: Find the organization's billing invoices, newest first. Invoices without a date sort first.
tool_descriptions.find_lead_custom_fields: List all lead custom fields defined for the organization. Returns each field's ID, name, description, type, allowed choices (for choice fields), whether multiple values are accepted, and whether it is a shared field. Useful for deciding which custom field to read or write when working with leads.
tool_descriptions.find_lead_statuses: List or find lead statuses for the organization
tool_descriptions.find_meeting_outcomes: List all outcomes applicable to meetings available in the organization.
tool_descriptions.find_memberships: List the organization's members with each member's role name, whether the role is built-in or custom, active/inactive status, and join date. Richer than org_users — prefer this unless you only need a name or email. Most recent members first.
tool_descriptions.find_notes: Find notes based on various filters.
tool_descriptions.find_notifications: Find items in the current user's inbox, such as incoming emails and SMS, missed calls, voicemails, tasks, and drafts waiting for review. By default returns the items in the inbox today.
tool_descriptions.find_opportunities: Find opportunities by status (active/won/lost), owner, lead, or close-date range, optionally only those needing attention, sorted by soonest close, largest value, or highest confidence. Returns each opportunity with resolved lead, contact, owner, and status names; cursor-paginated.
tool_descriptions.find_opportunity_custom_fields: List all opportunity custom fields defined for the organization. Includes both opportunity-specific fields and shared fields associated with opportunities. Returns each field's ID, name, description, type, allowed choices (for choice fields), whether multiple values are accepted, and whether it is a shared field. Useful for deciding which custom field to read or write when working with opportunities.
tool_descriptions.find_pipelines_and_opportunity_statuses: List all opportunity pipelines and their opportunity statuses in the organization.
tool_descriptions.find_scheduling_links: List available scheduling links for the user and org. User-owned personal links come with a URL. Shared links come with a special template tag. Each can be inserted into generated templates.
tool_descriptions.find_tasks: Find tasks based on various filters. You can filter by lead, assignee, completion state, and due/created/ updated dates.
tool_descriptions.find_voice_agents: List all voice agents configured for the organization. Voice agents are AI callers that place outbound calls to leads' contacts on the user's behalf. Returns each voice agent's ID, name and whether it is active. Use this to find the right voice agent ID when scheduling a call or assigning a call step in a workflow. Users may refer to voice agents as "voice agents", "Chloe", or by their configured name. When more than one agent exists, pick the most appropriate one based on the name.
tool_descriptions.get_ai_credit_usage: AI credit usage for the billing account, broken down by feature. Reports total credits used and a per-feature breakdown. Credits are the billing unit for AI features. Usage covers the whole billing account, not a single organization. Omit start/end for the current billing period; the result's start/end report the window actually measured. Explicit ranges must be timezone-aware and span at most 366 days. Older ranges may return empty or partial data — zero usage for an old range does not mean no usage.
tool_descriptions.get_billing_summary: Billing summary for the organization's billing account. Reports the subscription plan, billing status with the trial end date, seat counts, and AI usage availability, tier, and credit allowance for the current billing cycle. Whether the account is on trial is status, not anything under ai_usage. Use get_ai_credit_usage for the credits actually used.
tool_descriptions.get_fields: Get the fields the aggregation tool can use. Without arguments, return an overview of every type: its column fields with value types and enum values, and how the types relate. With object_type, return every field of that type as JSON, including the other indexed fields, smart fields (num_, last_, first_*, ...) and the organization's custom fields with their choices; narrow the listing with name_contains.
tool_descriptions.get_voice_agent_overview_report: Cross-agent rollup for the Voice Agents list page. Returns one row per active agent — agents with completed calls in date_range or queued upcoming calls. Cumulative funnel counts (answered, engaged, objective_met) plus total_calls. upcoming_calls is the agent's queued (not yet completed) calls and is not bound by date_range — open tasks are open regardless of when scheduled (so an agent with only upcoming calls still appears). Use this to compare agents; for one agent's numbers, use get_voice_agent_performance_report.
tool_descriptions.get_voice_agent_performance_report: Performance metrics for one voice agent. Returns the numbers shown on the Performance tab of a Voice Agent detail page. Passing multiple agent_config_ids pools metrics into a single aggregate (not a per-agent breakdown — for that, use get_voice_agent_overview_report). For per-call drill-down, search Calls filtered by agent_config_id. When the user is on a Voice Agent page, pull date_range from page_context.date_range so the numbers match the UI. Accepts a relative range such as last_week.
tool_descriptions.get_voice_agents: Return detailed configuration for one or more voice agents. Includes each agent's objective, user instructions, and which skills are enabled. Use this as the follow-up to find_voice_agents once one or more agent IDs have been selected.
tool_descriptions.lead_search: Perform a simple lead search and return the initial set of results. Use this to retrieve all leads, most recent leads, search leads by keyword, or filter by lead status and smart view. For more complex searches use the search tool instead. Leads will be returned by last updated first. Then fetch the record this returns.
tool_descriptions.list_membership_requests: List pending requests to join the current organization. Each entry includes the requesting user's name and email, the request id, and when the request was created.
tool_descriptions.list_roles: List the roles that can be assigned in the organization. Covers Close's built-in roles plus any custom roles the org defines. Use this to resolve a role name to its id, or to see which roles grant organization management access.
tool_descriptions.org_info: Return general information about the organization and the user.
tool_descriptions.org_users: Return active users (memberships) which are part of the current org.
tool_descriptions.paginate_search: Paginate a search to retrieve more results. Provide exactly one of: - search_id: a share_* id from a previous search or shared entry, or - smart_view_id: a save_* Smart View (saved search) id the user is viewing.
tool_descriptions.propose_voice_agent_update: Propose a voice agent configuration update from natural-language feedback. This tool does not apply changes to the voice agent. It returns a short behavioral summary and proposal ID when the requested edit is clear. If the feedback is ambiguous, it returns clarification questions instead of making a proposal. Applying a proposal is not available here: give the person its summary to apply in Close.
tool_descriptions.render_email_template: Render an email template for a lead, including any template variables. Body HTML already contains the user's email signature, in its own tag. Leave that tag intact or the signature could get duplicated later.
tool_descriptions.search: Perform a natural language search for leads or contacts. If a more specific search tool (like lead_search or activity_search) satisfies the request, use that tool instead. You can reference related objects like activities (such as calls, emails, meetings, notes, custom activities, etc.), opportunities, tasks as long as they are part of a lead query. Example queries: - leads not contacted in the past week - leads assigned to me with uncompleted tasks - leads with an active opportunity over $500. Then fetch the record this returns.
tool_descriptions.create_address: Add a new address to an existing lead (company).
tool_descriptions.create_comment: Add a comment to a commentable object (note, call, opportunity, task, custom object, etc.). If the object already has a comment thread, the new comment is appended to it. Otherwise a new thread is started for the object. Use this tool for both starting a conversation and replying to an existing one — the object_id alone determines which. Comments support @-mentions of users and groups. The body is HTML.
tool_descriptions.create_contact: Create a new contact for a lead. A contact represents a person associated with a lead (company).
tool_descriptions.create_custom_activity_instance: Create a new custom activity instance on a lead. A custom activity instance is an activity of a custom activity type, holding the custom field values defined by that type. Use the find_custom_activities tool to look up the available custom activity types. If in an interactive session, ask the user for the relevant field values (including custom fields) before creating, even if they are not required.
tool_descriptions.create_custom_object_instance: Create a new custom object instance on a lead. A custom object instance is a record of a custom object type, attached to a lead and holding the custom field values defined by that type. Use the find_custom_object_types tool to look up the available custom object types. If in an interactive session, ask the user for the relevant field values (including custom fields) before creating, even if they are not required.
tool_descriptions.create_draft_email: Create a draft email on a lead. The email is saved as an unsent draft for the user to review, edit, and send from Close; it is never sent automatically. Provide the body as Close rich text (HTML) via body_html; the sender's saved email signature is appended automatically. To create a reply in an existing thread, provide the ID of the email being replied to via in_reply_to_id.
tool_descriptions.create_email_template: Create a new email template. Handling of attachments and unsubscribe links via this tool is currently unsupported. Email template body should be HTML formatted. Use template tags as placeholders, for example: {{ organization.name }} to refer to the sender's organization name. {{ user.first_name }} {{ user.last_name }} {{ user.email }} {{ user.phone }} to refer to the user sending the email. {{ lead.display_name }} to refer to the lead name (recipient's name/company). {{ contact.first_name }} to refer to the contact's first name.
tool_descriptions.create_lead: Create a new lead (company). After creating a lead, you should usually add an address or contact (including phone or email) to the lead.
tool_descriptions.create_note: Create a new note on a lead. A note is a text-based activity attached to a lead. At least one of note (plaintext) or note_html (rich text) must be provided.
tool_descriptions.create_opportunity: Create a new opportunity. Requires a lead ID and status ID. Other fields are optional. The value should be specified in cents (e.g., $100.00 = 10000).
tool_descriptions.create_pipeline: Create a new opportunity pipeline. Use create_opportunity_status_tool to add statuses to the pipeline.
tool_descriptions.create_smart_view: Save a search as a smart view (saved search). Pass the ID of a search result that lists one object type: leads, contacts, opportunities, or one kind of activity. The smart view gets that search's filters, sort, and columns, so it lists exactly what was previewed. Confirm the name and criteria with the user before creating the view.
tool_descriptions.create_sms_template: Create a new SMS template. Handling of attachments via this tool is currently unsupported. Use template tags as placeholders, for example: {{ organization.name }} to refer to the sender's organization name. {{ user.first_name }} {{ user.last_name }} {{ user.email }} {{ user.phone }} to refer to the user sending the message. {{ lead.display_name }} to refer to the lead name (recipient's name/company). {{ contact.first_name }} {{ contact.last_name }} to refer to the recipient.
tool_descriptions.create_task: Create a new task for a lead. A task represents a to-do item that can be assigned to a user and optionally associated with a contact.
tool_descriptions.create_workflow: Create a new workflow (a.k.a. sequence) with Draft status.
tool_descriptions.update_call_task: Update a call task. Only fields that are provided will be updated. Reassigning to a user or voice agent (agent_config_id) affects only this task. Do not reassign a call task to a voice agent: the voice agent would place the call. Completing a call task also completes every sibling task sharing its deduplication key.
tool_descriptions.update_contact: Update an existing contact. You can update a contact's name, title, email addresses, phone numbers, and URLs. Only fields that are provided will be updated.
tool_descriptions.update_custom_activity_instance: Update an existing custom activity instance. A custom activity instance is an activity of a custom activity type, holding the custom field values defined by that type. Only fields that are provided will be updated. For custom fields, only the custom fields included are modified; pass null to clear one. Pass 'clear' for contact_id to detach the contact.
tool_descriptions.update_custom_object_instance: Update an existing custom object instance. A custom object instance is a record of a custom object type, attached to a lead and holding the custom field values defined by that type. Only fields that are provided will be updated. For custom fields, only the custom fields included are modified; pass null to clear one.
tool_descriptions.update_draft_email: Update an existing draft email. Only draft emails can be updated; sent or scheduled emails are rejected. Only fields that are provided are changed. When the body is replaced the sender's saved email signature is appended again. This never sends the email.
tool_descriptions.update_email_template: Update an existing email template. Only fields that are provided and not None will be updated. Handling of attachments and unsubscribe links via this tool is currently unsupported. Email template body should be HTML formatted. Use template tags as placeholders, for example: {{ organization.name }} to refer to the sender's organization name. {{ user.first_name }} {{ user.last_name }} {{ user.email }} {{ user.phone }} to refer to the user sending the email. {{ lead.display_name }} to refer to the lead name (recipient's name/company).
tool_descriptions.update_lead: Update an existing lead (company). Only fields that are provided and not None will be updated.
tool_descriptions.update_lead_smart_view: Update a lead smart view (saved search). Only fields that are provided and not None will be updated.
tool_descriptions.update_lead_status: Update the label of an existing lead status.
tool_descriptions.update_note: Update an existing note. Only fields that are provided will be updated. Note content is provided as rich text (HTML) via note_html; the plaintext note is automatically derived.
tool_descriptions.update_opportunity: Update an existing opportunity. Only fields that are provided will be updated. The value should be specified in cents (e.g., $100.00 = 10000).
tool_descriptions.update_opportunity_status_tool: Update the label of an existing opportunity status.
tool_descriptions.update_pipeline: Update an existing opportunity pipeline. Only fields that are provided will be updated.
tool_descriptions.update_sms_template: Update an existing SMS template. Only fields that are provided will be updated. Fields that are not provided will remain unchanged. Handling of attachments via this tool is currently unsupported. Use template tags as placeholders, for example: {{ organization.name }} to refer to the sender's organization name. {{ user.first_name }} {{ user.last_name }} {{ user.email }} {{ user.phone }} to refer to the user sending the message. {{ lead.display_name }} to refer to the lead name (recipient's name/company).
tool_descriptions.update_task: Update an existing task. Only fields that are provided will be updated. Pass 'clear' for contact_id or due_date to clear those values.
